WITH scan_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    crewref,
    gbsize / spanmin as gb_per_min
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin != 0
),
operator_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    crewref,
    COUNT(*) as num_scans,
    AVG(gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scan_metrics
  GROUP BY crewref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as overall_avg
  FROM operator_stats
),
filtered_operators AS (
  SELECT 
    os.num_scans,
    os.avg_gb_per_min,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM operator_stats os
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(num_scans) as avg_num_scans,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min - overall_avg) as avg_margin_above
FROM filtered_operators;
